validation_rules.row_resolution: Both source and target IDs must be present in core_rows.ndjson (plan gate).
validation_rules.EXACT_BODY: sha256(row.text) == proof text_sha256 for both endpoints.
validation_rules.NORMALIZED_REPLAY: row.canonical_sha256 == proof canonical hash for both endpoints; endpoint raw text_sha256 values differ; proof raw_class_count equals recomputed distinct raw classes.
validation_rules.PARENT_DIRECT: target.parent_id == source; source row must exist (external parent edges are flagged).
validation_rules.SAME_PARENT_SIBLING: Both endpoints share a non-null parent_id.
validation_rules.MARKER_SAME: Proof marker is in both endpoints' markers list and marker is non-endpoint.
validation_rules.MARKER_ENDPOINT: Proof marker is in both endpoints' markers list and marker matches endpoint classification.

proof_mapping.EXACT_BODY: proof = text_sha256=<sha256(raw text)> rows=<group size>; group size is the number of rows sharing that raw text hash.
proof_mapping.NORMALIZED_REPLAY: proof = canonical_sha256=<sha256(canonical text)>; raw_class_count=<number of distinct raw text hashes in the normalized group> rows=<number of representatives/raw classes>; edges connect one representative from each raw class.
proof_mapping.PARENT_DIRECT: proof = stored parent_id=<parent row id>; one edge per row whose stored parent_id is not null.
proof_mapping.SAME_PARENT_SIBLING: proof = shared_parent=<parent row id> rows=<number of siblings for that parent>; edges form a position-ordered chain over sibling rows.
proof_mapping.MARKER_SAME: proof = <exact bracketed marker> rows=<number of rows containing that exact marker>; edges form a position-ordered chain.
proof_mapping.MARKER_ENDPOINT: proof = <exact bracketed marker> rows=<number of rows containing that exact marker>; edge type is endpoint/transit markers matching is_endpoint().

canonical_replay.raw_classes_accounted: raw_class_count field in each proof, validated against distinct text_sha256 values among rows sharing canonical_sha256
canonical_replay.status: all NORMALIZED_REPLAY proofs map correctly; no opcode/alias normalization beyond approved hugging face/hf and whitespace handling
